reason: A opens by owning the failed first campaign, then answers my worries directly: all-or-nothing refund, only $49,000 left after bank and business pledges, the roof-cost risk disclosed, quarterly spending reports and a Thanksgiving reopening. B is unfinished, with placeholders for the cinema's name and a bracketed refund promise, and asks for more with fewer safeguards, so I'd trust it less with money I've little to spare.
